When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.

687-4771-4929-5641-5684.notablePrerequisites: If Myr Scrapling is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. 687-4771-4929-5641-5684.description:
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Myr Scrapling enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Myr Scrapling.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Myr Scrapling and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
687-4771-4929-5641-5684.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo.

 You control a nontoken nonartifact land.
